description: This PHP class, CategoriesTransformer, is part of the Goteo package and is responsible for transforming category models, providing URLs and accessors for category data, including actions, API properties, social commitments, SDGs, footprints, and categories. It extends an abstract transformer class and interacts with user permissions and model methods.

classes.name: CategoriesTransformer
classes.description: Transformer class for category models, providing URL generation and data retrieval based on category model properties and user permissions.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Returns a set of actions (such as edit and translate URLs) based on user permissions.

methods.name: getApiProperty
methods.description: Constructs and returns API URL for a given property of the category model.

methods.name: getSocial_commitment
methods.description: Returns the name of the social commitment associated with the category, if any.

methods.name: getSdgs
methods.description: Returns the SDGs related to the category model.

methods.name: getFootprints
methods.description: Returns footprints related to the category model.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Returns categories related to the category model.

methods.name: getSocial_commitments
methods.description: Returns social commitments related to the category model.

methods.name: getLanding_match
methods.description: Returns the landing match property of the model.

methods.name: getLink
methods.description: Returns a URL link based on type and key parameters, currently implemented to return empty strings.
